<Note>
These pages are **documentation cookbooks** for TypeScript workflows built with `terse-sdk` and `terse-cli`. This is separate from **Agents** in the Terse web app: the platform no longer ships a catalog of in-app agent templates (or public HTTP routes to list or hydrate them). Use the examples here as copy-and-adapt starting points in your repo after `terse init`.
</Note>

Each template is a complete workflow you can adapt after scaffolding a Terse project. The `terse` CLI can scaffold TypeScript. The code examples in this section are TypeScript-first today because they use the broader generated helper surface.

## How to use a template

<Steps>
  <Step title="Scaffold the starter">

```bash
# TypeScript starter (default)
terse init acme-revenue

cd acme-revenue
```

  </Step>
  <Step title="Connect the required integrations">
    Open the integrations page with `terse integrate` and connect the systems the template expects.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Generate helpers">

```bash
terse generate
```

  </Step>
  <Step title="Test and deploy">

```bash
terse test --verbose
terse deploy
```

  </Step>
</Steps>
